content: Isal a Pɔl ntɔn baar mpa abà Ayudà
Kyakin, mɛ Pɔl, mbuur a bɔlokà a Klistɔ Yɛsu ntɔn bɛ, bɛ baar mpa làbà Ayudà,
mbalà yumwɛy, bɛ làkyàwem naa Nzam, unsà ngyɛb ande, kan'pɛ buur naa an'kyän ande màkwe ntɔn bɛ,
anà, u mbwo a imɛɛy, nde kan'mɛɛy ngyee, asànaa kàsön mɛ ya ikikye kusà.
Lan'taŋ bɛ, bɛ lan'kwo làmɛn naa un'yɛnà nà mɛ in'we awà muyöb ngyee a Klistɔ.
Ngyee ayi Nzam ya kàmɛɛy anki akà baar a ngyääl yàlyaaŋ, asànaa kan'swaŋ nde ya apanà, u mbwo a Dweelà, akà antööm in'kyɛɛl ande anà aŋangɔɔm:
baar mpa abà Ayudà bàmakyey unsà kwal nsil alà, baar a ndür mwɛy nsil ayi, bàŋàtüüb unsà ilää nsil aki, amu Klistɔ Yɛsu, u mbwo a Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ,
mɛ kàkyàbulà un'syääl u mbwo a kab a kab a ngway kan'pɛ Nzam musyäl unkaak a ngwal ande.
Mɛ in'wà kimbuur uboo a aŋikyɛɛl banswà, nde kan'pɛ kab a ngway mukyään un'naaŋ a Klistɔ wà ipepey akà baar mpa abà Ayudà,
anà musà unsà pɛɛlà naa Nzam afàkwey aben ngyee yàkäl aŋàyee fà itaan amu nde, nde Nkyer a indiir byanswà.
Ntɔn, fà apanà, Amfum anà Aŋikɔ̈b u du, bàyöb an'yeerà a Nzam mà ifà ifà, u mbwo a Ikööŋ,
asànaa mböön a mbul a in'tye kàkwey nde amu Klistɔ Yɛsu, Mwol abi.
Abun, amu nde, u mbwo a làkwikilà ande, waa bi ban'sà mpem anà kam aŋàkwo musin tsütsü apà Nzam.
Abun sye, mɛ amàlalɔm naa twon lan'kwamà ntɔn mpay in'manà mɛ ntɔn bɛ: ya yà làkoo abɛ.
Ukwen a Klistɔ
Lalan, in'fàbwà mɛ an'köm kusà a Taa.
Ikɔb a bɔr lanswà, u du anà u mɛɛn, ifàfà amu nde,
mulab un'naaŋ a làkoo ande, wɛy nde kàlapɛ ngwal, u mbwo a Dweelà ande, ntɔn imbuur abɛ akyà uboo ikäl aŋàtsim,
wɛy nde ubwääy Klistɔ u mpem abɛ u mbwo a làkwikilà, wɛy bɛ làkäl bàŋàsà in'swɛy anà bàŋàtsim unsà ukwen,
waa bɛ làkal aŋàkwo muyöb, mbwo mwɛy anà aŋin'kyɛɛl banswà, naa ngyamà, uteer, bwɛl, iminà byà aben,
anà muyöb ukwen a Klistɔ ban'söön ngyööb yanswà, ntɔn bɛ làkäl bàŋàyuur tii muwal ngyööl a Nzam yanswà.
Apanà, akà nde akwà, u mbwo a unkaak a ngwal afàsal amu bi, kan'kwo mukyer indiir byàŋàsöön indiir byanswà ifàlɔm bi itàkal ifàyweer bi,
wɛy làkoo làkäl akà nde uboo a Ikööŋ anà amu Klistɔ Yɛsu, akà ngyääl yanswà, u mbul a in'tye! Wöwöö.
